# Charsley Digital

> Charsley Digital designs, builds, and hosts web platforms. Membership systems, match scoring, site traffic, and point of sale. Each platform runs in its own containers. The client keeps the data.

The public site is https://charsleydigital.co.za. Case studies live under https://charsleydigital.co.za/work.

## Live platforms

- [NRAPA](https://nrapa.ranyati.co.za): National Rifle and Pistol Association membership, compliance, certificates, and QR verification. Case study: https://charsleydigital.co.za/work/nrapa
- [SAPRF](https://saprf.co.za): South African Precision Rifle Federation. Membership, PRS and PR22 matches, payments, and national standings. Case study: https://charsleydigital.co.za/work/saprf
- [Pretoria Rifle & Pistol Club](https://pretoriaprc.co.za): Club membership, match entries, payments, endorsements, and certificates. Case study: https://charsleydigital.co.za/work/pprc
- [DeadCenter](https://deadcenter.co.za): Match scoring for shooting organisations, including an Android app for the range. Case study: https://charsleydigital.co.za/work/deadcenter
- [CentreVision](https://centrevision.co.za): Vehicle reads, watchlists, dwell, and traffic reports. It does not control gates. Case study: https://charsleydigital.co.za/work/centrevision
- [Ranyati Group](https://ranyati.co.za): Firearm licence motivations, NRAPA membership, secure storage, and used firearms. Also https://motivations.ranyati.co.za, https://nrapa.ranyati.co.za, https://storage.ranyati.co.za, https://arms.ranyati.co.za. Case study: https://charsleydigital.co.za/work/ranyati
- [Axionis POS](https://charsleydigital.co.za/work/axionis-pos): Point of sale. The sale at the counter stays in a system the business owns.
- [Charsley Digital](https://charsleydigital.co.za): This site, the enquiry form, and the admin that follows up.
